newsitem.title: UK: Britt Ekland collection fetches $146,800 at auction.
newsitem.headline: Britt Ekland collection fetches $146,800 at auction.

text.p: Personal items belonging to Swedish actress Britt Ekland, including the dress she wore when she wed British comedian Peter Sellers, sold for 88,000 pounds ($146,800) at auction on Tuesday, Christie's said.

The London auction house said Ekland, who also had a long relationship with British rock star Rod Stewart in the 1970s, decided to sell the contents of her British home because she had moved to Los Angeles to be close to her three children.
The most expensive item in the sale was a Galle Art Nouveau lamp which sold for 11,500 pounds, more than twice its estimated price.
The short ivory silk dress that Ekland wore when she married Sellers after a 15-day courtship in 1964 fetched 518 pounds and love letters from the comedian to his wife sold for 1,135 pounds.
"I'm sure she'll be very pleased, said Mark Wilkinson, Christie's specialist in 20th century decorative arts.
The 53-year-old Ekland, who was not present during the sale of the 200 lots, earlier said she liked the idea of getting rid of her past. ($1=.5995 Pound)
